items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: Because Alan Conner, that time he was upstairs with George McCubbin and all that bunch.

ctx.x: And I played around here with Rene, Kid Rene. On the parade. A lot of young men too. Played with Rene. We run parades. I played with Lee Collins, who he's dead too. Oh, yeah. I worked with Lee Collins at the La Vida and all. Oh, yeah. Because Alan Conner, that time he was upstairs with George McCubbin and all that bunch. Alvin Alcon. Oh, yeah. Alvin's brother I used to work with.
Oh, Alvin's brother? What's his name?
